visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The screen is organized into a triple-view layout. Top left features a square minimap showing player positions in a MOBA game. Top right captures the female creator from the chest up, seated in a high-back red and black gaming chair against a plain interior wall. She holds her smartphone horizontally with both hands, focusing intently. The bottom half is a large, high-definition screen recording of the mobile game character moving through a fantasy forest environment with vibrant green flora. (2) A sudden cut transitions the main gameplay window into an in-game item shop menu. A list of available weapons like swords and boots is displayed on the left side, each with gold prices and stat descriptions. The creator's face remains visible in the top corner, showing a brief moment of decision-making as she scrolls through the equipment list with her thumbs. (3) The view returns to the battlefield. The game character, controlled by the woman, engages in a skirmish with multiple enemy units. Flashy purple and blue particle effects explode across the screen as abilities are cast. Floating numbers indicating damage dealt appear over characters. Text overlays with social media handles persist at the bottom of the frame while colorful variety captions highlight key moments. (4) The game screen minimizes as a large overlay of the creator laughing appears. She smiles widely, her eyes squinting with joy. A hand reaches into the frame from above to affectionately pat her head, though the owner of the hand remains off-screen. The background is a simple room setting, and the overall lighting is bright and even.
